name: 6 Jokers

features.name: Joker top reel

features.name: Multiplier bombs
features.description: A full joker reel unlocks additive multiplier bombs.

review:
6 Jokers is a neon retro slot on a 6x5 grid with an extra, initially empty reel on top. Every spin, a joker appears in a random position on that extra reel and acts as a wild.

Winning symbols tumble away, but jokers stay, and each cascade adds another joker to the top reel. If the top reel fills with jokers, multiplier bombs can appear during a tumble, and several can land at once and add together. An ante bet is available. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.55%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
